facts.label: Day length at the equator today
Sun rises due east, sets due west

pilgrimages.name: Sizdah Bedar
pilgrimages.where: Iran and Persian diaspora — parks, riverbanks
pilgrimages.what: Thirteenth day of Nowruz. Families walk into nature, scatter sprouted lentils into running water, and walk home.

pilgrimages.name: Equinox sunrise at Chichen Itza
pilgrimages.what: Thousands gather to watch the late-afternoon serpent shadow descend the Pyramid of Kukulkan.
pilgrimages.source: INAH (Instituto Nacional de Antropología e Historia)

facts.label: Tropic of Cancer — sun directly overhead

pilgrimages.name: Stonehenge sunrise gathering
pilgrimages.what: Open-access dawn vigil organized by English Heritage. Thousands walk the avenue from the Heel Stone to the center as the sun rises.

pilgrimages.name: Midsommar processions
pilgrimages.what: Public holiday Friday between Jun 19–25. Walks to maypoles, dancing, picking seven flowers in silence on the walk home.

pilgrimages.name: Inti Raymi (returning to winter, Southern Hemisphere)
pilgrimages.what: Multi-day Inca-tradition procession from Sacsayhuaman to the sacred fields. Walking the route at dawn to 'tie the sun' against further descent.
pilgrimages.source: Bauer and Dearborn, Astronomy and Empire in the Ancient Andes

facts.label: From here, northern nights grow longer

pilgrimages.name: Chuseok (beolcho)
pilgrimages.what: Walking out to ancestral graves to clear them; returning home to share harvest food and watch the round moon rise.
pilgrimages.source: Lee, Korean Folk Belief and Folktales

pilgrimages.name: Mid-Autumn Festival lantern walks
pilgrimages.where: China, Vietnam, Hong Kong, diaspora communities
pilgrimages.what: Lantern walks at dusk under the harvest moon; walking to high places to see the moon rise complete.
pilgrimages.source: Stepanchuk and Wong, Mooncakes and Hungry Ghosts

facts.label: From here, light returns
facts.value: northern days grow until summer solstice

pilgrimages.name: Newgrange dawn lottery
pilgrimages.what: A handful of winners (drawn months in advance) enter the chamber at dawn to witness sunlight reach the burial stone for ~17 minutes — the design intent of a 5,200-year-old monument.

pilgrimages.name: Stonehenge sunset gathering
pilgrimages.what: Less crowded than midsummer. Walkers gather to watch the sun set behind the great trilithon.

pilgrimages.name: Dongzhi family walks
pilgrimages.what: Family gathering, temple visits, eating tangyuan to mark the year's deepest dark and the return of yang.
pilgrimages.source: Stepanchuk and Wong, Mooncakes and Hungry Ghosts

pilgrimages.name: Inti Raymi (Southern Hemisphere — winter solstice)
pilgrimages.what: See summer solstice notes — same date, opposite hemisphere.
pilgrimages.source: Bauer and Dearborn, Astronomy and Empire in the Ancient Andes
